## Detect what others miss

### The ATCC Universal Mycoplasma Detection Kit detects over 120 species with high sensitivity,
### helping you protect the integrity of your cell cultures and ensure confidence in your results.

[Learn more][10]

## Physiologically relevant PBMCs

### Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) deliver consistent, assay-ready performance to model
### responses and generate reliable data.

[Learn more][11]

## Build better, more reliable molecular diagnostic assays

### Power your assays with quantitative genomic and synthetic nucleic acids designed for accuracy,
### confidence, and reproducibility.

[Explore now][12]

## More predictive research starts with advanced models

### Leverage human‑relevant organoid models to gain deeper insights into disease biology and
### therapeutic response.

[Explore organoids][13]

 

[ [Fluorescent blue and green spheres of leukemic cells.] ][14]

Discover advanced biological models and patient-derived cell lines that can help you transform the
cancer treatment landscape.

your research and testing process.

[Explore new products][27]
[ [Scientists Working in The Laboratory iStock-1181391587.jpg] ][28]

### Coming Soon Products

development, drug discovery, toxicology profiling, analytical testing, and more.

ATCC (American Type Culture Collection) is a nonprofit, global biological resource center and
standards organization and the leading developer and supplier of authenticated cells lines and
microorganisms. We leverage our rich history and knowledge to provide the products, services, and
resources scientists need to conduct critical life science research.

We believe better science starts with better solutions. From discovery through translational
research to clinical applications, we empower scientists and clinicians to advance science faster.

### Introducing Our Portfolio of Brands:

[R&D Systems by Bio-Techne Logo]

With decades of innovation and attentive support, our trusted protein analysis reagents and
instruments enable science to move forward with confidence.

[Discover R&D Systems →][156]
[Bio-Techne Spatial Logo]

From tissue to insight, our targeted spatial biology solutions enable clear, confident decisions
across biomarker discovery, translational research, and patient care.

[Discover Bio-Techne Spatial →][157]
[Bio-Techne Diagnostics Logo]

When results matter most, clinical labs and assay developers rely on our precision product suite and
expertise to deliver consistent, accurate answers that enable confident decisions.

[Discover Bio-Techne Diagnostics →][158]

For 50 years, we have supported your breakthroughs, providing the products, tools, and scientific

### Proteomic Applications

[Proteomic Applications]

Access tools that reveal protein behavior, from expression to interactions, to advance disease
insights, biomarker discovery, and therapeutic development.

[Learn More →][173]

### Cell-Based Therapies

[Cell-Based Therapies]

Providing reliable phase-appropriate reagents and flexible technologies, along with expert support,
to streamline development and scale-up manufacturing processes.

[Learn More →][174]

### Spatial Biology

[Spatial Biology]

Enabling scalable and reliable workflows for RNA, protein, and multiomic detection with our
best-in-class reagents, instruments, and analysis solutions.

[Learn More →][175]

### Precision Diagnostics

[Precision Diagnostics]

Delivering quality controls, reagents, and assay development & manufacturing, plus molecular kits
that simplify workflows and resolve hard-to-detect targets.

## Delivering Excellence Through Science With Quality, Trust And Innovation.

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

### Amines

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Contract Manufacture

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

Products

## Explore Our Products
* [
  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.
  
  Explore More
  ][167]
* [
  Tumor Cell Lines
  
  Tumor cell lines, also called Cancer cell lines, are an important part of tumors, they are the
  main component of tumors and tissue specific. Cancer cells have three important basic
  characteristics: immortality, migration, and loss of contact inhibition. In addition, carcinoma
  cells have many physiological, biochemical, and morphological characteristics that are different
  from normal cells. Different cancer cell lines provide a wide range of experimental materials for
  studying the occurrence and development of tumors and have played an important role in the
  in-depth study of tumor immunotherapy, tumor-targeted therapy, and tumor resistance.
  
  Explore More
  ][168]
* [
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines
  
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines is an important research tool for pharmaceutical drug discovery,
  compound screening, and gene therapy research. The transfected stable cell lines are constructed
  by integrating the exogenous plasmid DNA into the host cell chromosome so that the host cell can
  express the protein of interest for a long period of time. Key Features of AcceGen Transfected
  Stable Cell Lines: ● The exogenous fragment can be stably expressed in dividing cells for a long
  time (> 2 weeks). ● Establishing stable cell lines can help screen appropriate number of cells for
  experimental research. ● By establishing stable cell lines, the cost of excessive conversion of
  dyes or virus packaging can be greatly reduced, and experimental research is greatly facilitated.
  ● Establishing stable cell lines can achieve better genetic interference effects. ● It can
  effectively eliminate the interference of individual differences (the same type of cells,
  different individual cell genomes) on the experimental results. AcceGen is committed to providing
  ready-to-go stable cell lines and knockout cell lysate for your basic research. Use the Mutant
  Gene Nomenclature to search, if you cannot find the specific product in our database, AcceGen
  Custom Stable Cell Lines Service is committed to pave new ways to meet all your needs.
  
  Explore More
  ][169]
* [
  Immortalized Cell Lines
  
  After the primary cells experience limited population proliferation during the culture process,
  the primary cells cease to proliferate. Immortalized cells are derived from primary cells:
  exogenous immortalized genes (EBV, HPV E6 / 7 and SV40 T antigens of recombinant lentivirus,
  retrovirus & adenovirus, hTERT, p53) are introduced into target cells by gene transfection
  technology and immortalized cell lines are established to achieve cell culture in vitro so that
  cells cultured in vitro have the ability to proliferate and there is no difference between cells.
  Through immortalization, those cells that are difficult to pass down, slow to proliferate, and
  easy to age can be immortalized, thereby providing researchers with more cell resources and
  providing a good in vitro cell model for scientific research. AcceGen has about 60 kinds of
  immortalised cell lines, including human immortalised cells, mouse immortalised cells, and rat
  immortalised cells. AcceGen also provides Custom Cell Immortalization Service for your unique
  solutions.
  
  Explore More
  ][170]
* [
  Stem Cells
  
  Stem Cells, also calls Progenitor Cells, are a kind of self-replicating pluripotent cells, which
  can differentiate into multiple functional cells under certain conditions. Given this
  characteristic, some diseases can be cured by transplanting stem cells or related derivatives into
  patients to replace damaged cells. Stem cells have become the frontier and hotspot of life science
  and medical research at the beginning of this century because of the broad application prospects
  in the fields of disease treatment and regenerative medicine.
  
  Explore More
  ][171]
* [
  MicroRNA Agomir/Antagomir
  
  MicroRNA (miRNA) is a type of endogenous small RNA with a length of about 20-24 nucleotides. A
  combination of several miRNAs can be used to fine-tune the expression of a gene. MicroRNA Agomir
  is a special-labeled and chemically modified double-stranded small RNA that mimics the endogenous
  miRNA to regulate the biological function of the target gene. MicroRNA Antagomir is an especially
  chemically modified miRNA antagonist. It strongly competes with mature miRNAs in the body to
  prevent the complementary pairing of miRNAs and their target genes, thereby inhibiting miRNAs from
  functioning. NOMENCLATURE 1. The miRNA mature body is abbreviated as miR, and then according to
  its species name, such as the human being abbreviated as hsa, and the order in which it was found
  is represented by Arabic numerals, such as hsa-miR-122. 2. Highly homologous miRNAs are followed
  by lowercase letters (a, b, c, ...), such as hsa-miR-34a, hsa-miR-34b, hsa-miR-34c, and so on. 3.

* [
  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.
  
  Explore More
  ][167]
* [
  Tumor Cell Lines
  
  Tumor cell lines, also called Cancer cell lines, are an important part of tumors, they are the
  main component of tumors and tissue specific. Cancer cells have three important basic
  characteristics: immortality, migration, and loss of contact inhibition. In addition, carcinoma
  cells have many physiological, biochemical, and morphological characteristics that are different
  from normal cells. Different cancer cell lines provide a wide range of experimental materials for
  studying the occurrence and development of tumors and have played an important role in the
  in-depth study of tumor immunotherapy, tumor-targeted therapy, and tumor resistance.
  
  Explore More
  ][168]
* [
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines
  
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines is an important research tool for pharmaceutical drug discovery,
  compound screening, and gene therapy research. The transfected stable cell lines are constructed
  by integrating the exogenous plasmid DNA into the host cell chromosome so that the host cell can
  express the protein of interest for a long period of time. Key Features of AcceGen Transfected
  Stable Cell Lines: ● The exogenous fragment can be stably expressed in dividing cells for a long
  time (> 2 weeks). ● Establishing stable cell lines can help screen appropriate number of cells for
  experimental research. ● By establishing stable cell lines, the cost of excessive conversion of
  dyes or virus packaging can be greatly reduced, and experimental research is greatly facilitated.
  ● Establishing stable cell lines can achieve better genetic interference effects. ● It can
  effectively eliminate the interference of individual differences (the same type of cells,
  different individual cell genomes) on the experimental results. AcceGen is committed to providing
  ready-to-go stable cell lines and knockout cell lysate for your basic research. Use the Mutant
  Gene Nomenclature to search, if you cannot find the specific product in our database, AcceGen
  Custom Stable Cell Lines Service is committed to pave new ways to meet all your needs.
  
  Explore More
  ][169]
* [
  Immortalized Cell Lines
  
  After the primary cells experience limited population proliferation during the culture process,
  the primary cells cease to proliferate. Immortalized cells are derived from primary cells:
  exogenous immortalized genes (EBV, HPV E6 / 7 and SV40 T antigens of recombinant lentivirus,
  retrovirus & adenovirus, hTERT, p53) are introduced into target cells by gene transfection
  technology and immortalized cell lines are established to achieve cell culture in vitro so that
  cells cultured in vitro have the ability to proliferate and there is no difference between cells.
  Through immortalization, those cells that are difficult to pass down, slow to proliferate, and
  easy to age can be immortalized, thereby providing researchers with more cell resources and
  providing a good in vitro cell model for scientific research. AcceGen has about 60 kinds of
  immortalised cell lines, including human immortalised cells, mouse immortalised cells, and rat
  immortalised cells. AcceGen also provides Custom Cell Immortalization Service for your unique

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

1999

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2001

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015

2017

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

# The Personal Journey That Led to Cell Forté

How my mother's battle with dementia led me to discover the future of skincare

What began as a search for solutions to support my mother became a revolutionary breakthrough in
cellular skincare. This is the story of science, love, and the relentless pursuit of innovation.

[ Discover Cell Forté ][1]

Dear Friend,

I never set out to revolutionize skincare.

Like many daughters, I was simply searching for answers - desperate to help my mother as she battled
dementia. That search took me deep into the world of regenerative medicine, where I discovered
something remarkable: stem cell research facilities conducting medical trials that were producing
clinical-grade human mesenchymal stem cell conditioned media.

These trials were showing extraordinary results in tissue regeneration and cellular repair. Lives
were being transformed in clinical settings.

And yet, this breakthrough technology had never been available commercially.

## The "Aha" Moment

I couldn't stop thinking about it. If this cellular technology could help regenerate damaged tissue
in medical applications, what could it do for skin - our largest organ?

*Not plant stem cells. Not synthetic alternatives.* But real human mesenchymal stem cell conditioned
media - the same clinical-grade material being used in medical research.

I spent years working with scientists and researchers to bring this innovation to life. The
challenges were immense. This wasn't just another skincare launch - we were bringing medical-grade
biotechnology into a commercial product for the first time.

## The Result: Cell Forté Serum

First of Its Kind

Cell Forté Serum became the first commercially available skincare product formulated with authentic
human stem cell technology. *Not a synthetic substitute. Not a 'plant-based alternative.'* The real
innovation that I discovered in those medical research facilities.

Every bottle contains the same caliber of human mesenchymal stem cell conditioned media used in
regenerative medicine research - formulated specifically to support your skin's natural renewal
processes.

## Why This Matters

The beauty industry is filled with buzzwords and borrowed science. But Cell Forté is different. This
isn't marketing language - it's a genuine first-of-its-kind innovation that bridges the gap between
medical-grade biotechnology and luxury skincare.

When you use Cell Forté, you're experiencing the same cellular technology that inspired my journey
from desperate daughter to founder of a brand built on real scientific breakthrough.

"This is the serum I wish existed when I started searching for answers all those years ago."

With gratitude,

Angela Caglia

"The same human mesenchymal stem cell technology that started this journey is in every bottle of
Cell Forté Serum."

## Welcome to Beike Biotechnology

Beike is the world’s largest stem cell provider focusing on the research, development, and clinical
translation of adult stem cells. In addition to stem cell therapy research, we have also developed a
range of immunotherapy treatments targeting a range of conditions. Our goal is to not only provide
high quality treatments to patients worldwide, but also to foster collaborations within the field of
regenerative medicine by working with governments and clinicians worldwide to provide efficacious
stem cell treatments.

## Beike History

Shenzhen Beike Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (Beike Biotech) is a biotechnology company based in Shenzhen,
China that specializes in the research, clinical translation, and technological advancement of adult
stem cells and their associated applications. Beike Biotechnology was founded in July 2005 with
investment from Peking University, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Shenzhen City
Hall and has recruited more than 700 employees since its inception. Our elite research and
development team is led by distinguished scientists from within the stem cell field. Today, Beike
continues to lead the way in adult stem cell research and development worldwide, providing novel
treatment approaches for currently incurable disease and chronic illnesses, which are, at present, a
challenge to treat for clinicians.

## Welcome to Beike Biotechnology

Beike is the world’s largest stem cell provider focusing on the research, development, and clinical
translation of adult stem cells. In addition to stem cell therapy research, we have also developed a
range of immunotherapy treatments targeting a range of conditions. Our goal is to not only provide
high quality treatments to patients worldwide, but also to foster collaborations within the field of
regenerative medicine by working with governments and clinicians worldwide to provide efficacious
stem cell treatments.

## Beike History

Shenzhen Beike Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (Beike Biotech) is a biotechnology company based in Shenzhen,
China that specializes in the research, clinical translation, and technological advancement of adult
stem cells and their associated applications. Beike Biotechnology was founded in July 2005 with
investment from Peking University, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Shenzhen City
Hall and has recruited more than 700 employees since its inception. Our elite research and
development team is led by distinguished scientists from within the stem cell field. Today, Beike
continues to lead the way in adult stem cell research and development worldwide, providing novel
treatment approaches for currently incurable disease and chronic illnesses, which are, at present, a
challenge to treat for clinicians.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

📥

Download full datasets in clean, structured formats. Your exports belong to you — not to a
subscription you might cancel.
🔄
Updated while you sleep

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.
